name: password-input
title: Password Input
description: A composed password input with show/hide toggle and optional strength indicator with criteria checklist.

docs.lead: A composed password input with show/hide toggle and optional strength indicator with criteria checklist. Built on Input primitives and LevelBar.

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Basic password input with show/hide toggle.

examples.title: With Strength
examples.description: Password input with strength indicator and criteria checklist.
examples.code:
<PasswordInput.Root
  showStrength
  criteria={[
    { key: 'length', label: 'At least 8 characters', met: true },
    { key: 'uppercase', label: 'At least 1 uppercase', met: false },
    { key: 'number', label: 'At least 1 number', met: false },
  ]}
/>

examples.title: With Form Field
examples.description: Password input composed with FormField for consistent label and hint.
examples.code:
<FormField.Root
  label="Password"
  htmlFor="password"
  required
  hint="Minimum 8 characters."
>
  <PasswordInput.Root id="password" />
</FormField.Root>

api.name: PasswordInput.Root
api.description: The composed password input component. Forwards ref to the underlying input element.

props.name: showIcon
props.description: Icon shown when password is hidden

props.name: hideIcon
props.description: Icon shown when password is visible

props.name: criteria
props.description: Strength criteria array: { key: string; label: string; met: boolean }
